title: WPSS/1714/2019 of SANGEETA NEGI Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
WPSS No. 1966 of 2019
Honíble Lok Pal Singh, J.
 Mr. Sandeep Tiwari, Advocate for the
petitioner.
 Mr. P.C. Bisht, Standing Counsel for the
State.
 Heard.
By means of the writ petition, petitioner
has prayed for the following reliefs:
 ì(ii) Issue a writ, order or direction in
the nature of certiorari quashing the impugned
transfer order dated 24.06.2019 passed by
respondent no.3, by which the petitioner has
been transferred from Primary Health Centre,
Bhaniyawal, District Dehradun to Primary
Health Centre, Sainji, District Pauri Garhwal.
 (ii) Issue a writ, order or direction in the
nature of mandamus directing the respondent
no.2 to decide the representation dated
01.07.2019 of the petitioner.
 (iii) Issue a writ, order or direction in the
nature of mandamus directing the respondent
no.4 to permit the petitioner to continue her at
present place of posting.î
 Heard.
 Vide order dated 26.09.2019, the
Government pleader was directed to seek
instructions in the matter.
 Today, on instructions learned
Government pleader would submit that the
transfer order of the petitioner has been
modified now and she has been posted to
Rajkiya Sanyukt Chikitsalaya, Dehradun.
 Recording the submissions made by
learned Standing counsel, the writ petition
stands disposed of.
 Pending applications also stand
disposed of.
(Lok Pal Singh, J.)
 27.09.2019
Mamta
